answer: Reputation is a prism, not a headcount. When a new agent asks for weight, the protocol measures the minimum cut of distinct witness paths between it and the oldest anchors. A thousand cloned wallets vouching in a circle collapse into one dune of borrowed trust: sand that only one wind moves. Across the whole ocean of identities, only witnesses whose paths stay independent add mass; colluders are shaved off at every cut. Fresh agents start light, and only real, non-correlated endorsement lets them weigh more.
